mechanism: Both agents are nephrotoxic and ototoxic; amikacin is an aminoglycoside with significant renal toxicity potential, and concurrent doxycycline use increases risk of acute kidney injury and eighth cranial nerve damage.
action: Monitor renal function (baseline and serial creatinine/BUN) and audiometry; ensure adequate hydration; consider alternative antibiotics if possible or use lowest effective doses with prolonged dosing intervals for amikacin.
